instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: If you want to learn English words, start with the ones people use often. That is clearly right, and no one can argue with it. Still, when a gotcha appears, the good student in you steps away. Maybe so, but what is the rarest word? Wait, you came here to study today, didn't you? Dopa English word gotcha is just right for distracting you. English word cards have seven levels of rarity. Words used more often have lower levels. Words used less often have higher levels. The words you should learn first seem boring in the game. Surprisingly, useful words and star power do not go together. Usually, you might ask, can I use this in a conversation? But now you may lean forward and ask, what? People hardly ever use this word. You check how rare it is before you read its meaning. You thought you were opening a word book, but in your mind, a send-off for rare word hunters is already starting.
